# TopologyCentricComputing

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A computing paradigm where the spatial arrangement and connectivity of processing elements (topology) are exploited to match the structure of the computational problem. For quantum gate synthesis, topology-centric mapping of quantum circuits onto physical qubit arrays could reduce communication overhead and improve fidelity, a key TCC concern.
